newsitem.title: USA: U.S. funds post inflows for 2-day period.
newsitem.headline: U.S. funds post inflows for 2-day period.

text.p: U.S. mutual funds had inflows of $1.233 billion for the two days ended Oct 14 compared with an outflow of $580 million for the three-day period ended Oct 10, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
The fund tracker said that U.S. equity funds had inflows of $969 million for the two days ended Oct 14 compared with an outflow of $300 million for the three-day period.
The fund tracker said that international funds had an inflow of $264 million compared with an outflow of $280 million.
Bond funds had an inflow of $47 million versus an outflow of $589 million.

Aggressive growth funds had inflows of $422 million versus outflows of $289 million, growth funds had inflows of $335 million versus outflows of $145 million, and growth and income funds had inflows of $209 million versus inflows of $221 million.

Municipal funds had inflows of $169 million versus outflows of $646 million; high-yield funds had outflows of $107 million versus inflows of $69 million. Corporate, income and global funds had an outflow of $40 million versus an inflow of $56 million.
